title: Messi will have no more secrets for you!
text: I offered this experience to my spouse who is an absolute fan of Lionel Messi and Barça in general. I really wasn't disappointed. Florent is very nice, he has an incredible amount of interesting stories to tell about the famous player and he answers all questions without any taboos. Even I'm less of a soccer fan, I haven't seen the time pass! We had a great time. If you are visiting Barcelona I recommend 100%. After that Messi will have no secrets for you and you can shine with your friends with new anecdotes!
author: liliadelaidecou

title: An unusual and authentic activity in Barcelona (for football fans, Messi... Or not!) Impossible to get bored
text:
Great activity to do in Barcelona whether you are here for a weekend or more. An unusual activity that goes off the beaten track and activities offered in Barcelona.
Here we talk about the world champion Messi!!! Florent is passionate and even knows Lionel Messi... so the time we spent together necessarily passes too quickly. Florent knows the champion well because he has lived in Argentina, is a sports journalist and has already interviewed Messi.
An activity to share with family, friends or even with your boyfriend (great surprise to do, no boredom possible even if you are not a fan of footb
author: Diana B

title: Messi as if you were there
text:
A great experience with Florent, whose passion is communicative and whose football knowledge is second to none. 
A dive into the intimate Messiah, against the backdrop of childhood in Buenos Aires, training and success in Barcelona, renewal in Paris... a magnificent journey for any fan of the round ball and the Pulga.

title: Great experience!
text: I really loved this experience around Messi, of whom I am a huge fan. With my wife, who is from Argentina, we were able to discover thanks to Florent many small stories around his childhood in Rosario and his arrival in Barcelona. Florent knows his career at his fingertips and with the incredible photos of young Leo he has on his iPad and those of his meetings with him, he really allowed us to discover the hidden side of this global star. Must do if you are passing through Barcelona and love Messi!
author: 140basiled

title: Great time!
text: Of Catalan origin, I had been thinking about going to Barcelona for quite some time. I took the opportunity to go for a trip to Camp Nou and do this experience with Florent. As an experienced journalist close to Messi’s entourage, he introduced me to many anecdotes I did not know and also travelled a little in Argentina, thanks to childhood photos of Messi and his neighborhood. I had a great time. Must do if you are a fan of the Flea!
